info.title: v2.global_product.update_global_item
info.description: Update global item. Only for China mainland sellers and Korean sellers.

post.description: Update global item. Only for China mainland sellers and Korean sellers.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: attribute_id
parameters.description: ID of attribute.

parameters.name: attribute_list
parameters.description: Item attributes.

parameters.name: brand_id
parameters.description: Id of brand.

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: Category id of global item.

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: Condition of global item, "NEW" or "USED" is available.

parameters.name: days_to_ship
parameters.description: Days to ship.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Description of global item.

parameters.name: description_info
parameters.description: New description field. New description field. Only whitelist sellers can use it. If you use the field, please upload the description_type=extended otherwise api will return error. If you don't use this field, you don't need to upload the description_type or upload description_type=normal

parameters.name: description_type
parameters.description: Values: See Data Definition- description_type (normal , extended). If you want to use extended_description or change description type ,this field must be inputed

parameters.name: dimension
parameters.description: The dimension of this global item. Updating the dimension of this global item will overwrite the dimension of all global models under this global item.

parameters.name: extended_description
parameters.description: If description_type is extended , Description information should be set by this field.

parameters.name: field_list
parameters.description: Field of extended description.

parameters.name: field_type
parameters.description: Type of extended description field ：values: See Data Definition- description_field_type (text , image).

parameters.name: global_item_id
parameters.description: Id of global item.

parameters.name: global_item_name
parameters.description: Name of global item.

parameters.name: global_item_sku
parameters.description: Sku of global item.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: Image information of global item.

parameters.name: image_id
parameters.description: Image id.

parameters.name: image_id_list
parameters.description: Image id list of global item.

parameters.name: image_info
parameters.description: If field_type is image, image url will be set by this field.

parameters.name: merchant_id
parameters.description: Shopee’s unique identifier for a merchant. Required for all merchant level requests(CB CNSC user calling global product related APIs).

parameters.name: original_value_name
parameters.description: Name of attribute value. original_value_name from global_product.get_attributes api. If value id=0, this field is required. If AttributeType is DATE_TYPE or TIMESTAMP_TYPE, you can upload timestamp(string type) as the original_value_name.

parameters.name: package_height
parameters.description: The height of package for this global item, the unit is CM.

parameters.name: package_length
parameters.description: The length of package for this global item, the unit is CM.

parameters.name: package_width
parameters.description: The width of package for this global item, the unit is CM.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: pre_order
parameters.description: Preorder information of global item. Updating the DTS of global item will overwrite the DTS of all global models under the global item

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, merchant_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: size_chart
parameters.description: ID of size chart image. If you want to remove the image size chart of the item, please pass the "size_chart" empty. You only need to fill out either the image or template. If both are filled, only the template will be kept. Notes: Both CB shops and local shops are supported to set "size_chart".

parameters.name: size_chart_id
parameters.description: ID of template size chart. If you want to remove the template size chart of the item, please pass the "size_chart_id" as 0. You only need to fill out either the image or template. If both are filled, only the template will be kept. Notes: Both local shops and CB shops are supported to set "size_chart_id" now and seller need set the size_chart template in CBSC in advance

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: If field_type is text, text information will be set by this field.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

parameters.name: value_id
parameters.description: ID of attribute value. In the following cases, the value id needs to be uploaded as 0, and original_value_name is mandatory, needs to be filled in customized value. (1) AttributeInputType is TEXT_FILED; (2) AttributeInputType is COMBO_BOX or MULTIPLE_SELECT_COMBO_BOX, and the seller want to fill in a customized value.

parameters.name: value_unit
parameters.description: Unit of attribute value.(quantitative attribute only)

parameters.name: video_upload_id
parameters.description: Video upload id of global item.

parameters.name: weight
parameters.description: The weight of this global item, the unit is KG. Updating the weight of this global item will overwrite the weight of all global models under this global item.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.
